bridge-type.label: ATS Advanced Panel
bridge-type.description: This Bridge defines the ATS Advanced Alarm System Control panel

parameter.name: ipAddress
parameter.label: Panel Address
parameter.description: Network address of the ATS Advanced panel

parameter.name: portNumber
parameter.label: Panel Port
parameter.description: TCP port number of the ATS Advanced panel

parameter.name: pin
parameter.label: PIN
parameter.description: User PIN for the panel (one active session per PIN)

parameter.name: gatewayUrl
parameter.label: Gateway URL
parameter.description: Base URL of the AtsAdvancedGateway HTTP service, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18137

channel-type.label: Monitor
channel-type.description: System monitor that contains a description of the most recent event that occurred at the ATS Advanced panel

channel-type.label: Engineer Reset
channel-type.description: Trigger engineer reset (createCC.ENG_RES → GETCODE → DORESET). Send ON.

channel-type.label: Battery Test
channel-type.description: Start/cancel battery test (createCC.DEVICE / fnCC.BATTERY_TEST_*). ON=start, OFF=cancel.

channel-type.label: Walk Test
channel-type.description: Start/stop panel walk-test for all areas (createCC.A_WALKTST). ON=start, OFF=stop.

channel-type.label: Log Entry
channel-type.description: Last event read from the panel log (select.getLOG)

channel-type.label: Fetch Log
channel-type.description: Read next log entry (first=latest, then older). Send ON.

channel-type.label: Log History
channel-type.description: Last 50 panel events (newest first), newline-separated. Filled from live monitor and/or fetchLogHistory.

channel-type.label: Fetch Log History
channel-type.description: Reload the last 50 events from the panel log into logHistory. Send ON.
